resolved_findings.original: mutation hooks attribute every pool write to pale:RS
resolved_findings.evidence: Fresh real two-pool decay controls in both insertion orders emitted exactly one selected Pale mutation, 100 to 98.

resolved_findings.evidence: Fresh OFF and ON controls both mutated aaa:RS 100 to 98, recorded one phase, then propagated the same original Pale getter exception.

resolved_findings.original: reader falsely qualifies incomplete or operand-poisoned evidence
resolved_findings.evidence: Fresh real-producer two-turn envelope accepted 22 rows/7 mutations with an explicit lawful turn-22 WIA unreached qualification; nine negative controls rejected missing phase, missing writer, poisoned direct/shared/decay/WIA/binding arithmetic, and invented skip semantics.

resolved_findings.original: default-OFF observer must not evaluate diagnostic-only manifest inputs
resolved_findings.evidence: Fresh gate control built the manifest zero times OFF, zero times with another selector, and once only after the complete ON gate.

remaining_blocker.title: ON expected-phase manifest construction remains uncontained and can reorder gameplay exceptions
remaining_blocker.detail: createPoolFlowObserver now defers the manifest callback until the complete topic/selector/turn gate, fixing OFF behavior, but invokes that diagnostic-only callback without a try/catch. The production callback reads working.meta.recruitment_mode before any War phase. A fresh accessor control showed OFF did not invoke the callback, while ON propagated the recruitment_mode getter exception from observer construction. Thus enabling stdout observation can still introduce/move an exception ahead of gameplay, contrary to the authorized requirement that ON-only reads be caught and never mask or reorder gameplay exceptions.
remaining_blocker.required_fix: Contain expected-manifest construction failure as diagnostic failure without throwing into gameplay, while retaining fail-closed terminal qualification. Verify ON/OFF exception and mutation order at this seam. Because this is a persistent residual after the one correction cycle, no further correction loop was run in this review.

qualification_limits: Readiness verification only. No campaign, full suite, build, replay, or runTurn was executed. This does not establish campaign neutrality, actual retained-run n84 writer values, historical causality, n80 causality, or acceptance of 703/712.
